_comment: MERGED roster — lane-systems character identities (complete, no numbers) x Godot v0.1 numeric loadouts. Signature items and skill trees live in the lane docs; v1 digital implements affinity, stats, one passive perk and one weakness each. heart = loved element (-1 F vs its creatures), cross = distrusted (+1 F, per creatures.md affinity rule).

characters.name: The Cartographer
characters.personality: Former ship's navigator — charts, paths, the unknown.

perk.name: Pathfinding
perk.desc: Moving across already-explored tiles costs no extra on Tier 2 (T2 entry 1 cheaper, min 1).

weakness.name: Restless
weakness.desc: Cannot choose the same main action two turns in a row.

characters.name: The Botanist
characters.personality: Ship's physician and naturalist — flora, potions, growth.

perk.name: Bountiful Harvest
perk.desc: +1 common when gathering on Jungle or Meadow.

weakness.name: Soft Step
weakness.desc: Draws one fewer common when gathering on Mountain or Volcano.

characters.name: The Blacksmith
characters.personality: Ship's carpenter and metalworker — structure, fire, patience.

weakness.name: Heavy Gear
weakness.desc: Lowest movement; storm setbacks cost an extra move.

characters.name: The Outcast
characters.personality: Stowaway and scavenger — isolation, guile, survival.

perk.name: Rage Capitalizer
perk.desc: +1 to fight draws while Island Rage is 6 or higher.

weakness.name: Distrusted
weakness.desc: Care-phase giving grants no Light on the round after any fight (won or lost).
